name: Underline
what_it_does: Toggles an underline on the selected text; the dropdown picks the underline style and color.
behavior: Opens subfeature:underline-gallery (dropdown). Contents (12 controls): Underline, Double underline, Thick underline, Dotted underline, Dashed underline, Dot-dash underline, Dot-dot-dash underline, Wave underline, No underline, More Underlines..., Underline Color, Color swatches. Sub-surfaces: ui:underline-menu-more-underlines. [the subfeature:underline-gallery flyout — items are endpoints; swatches pixel-sampled] Appears as a capital 'U' with an underline beneath it, plus a dropdown chevron.
